scope: CR5 GemARC, APP ABI 32, matching source/relink materials and selected extracted-package acceptance

coexistence.profile: 12 public Tasks, root fixture without the production desktop APP

strings.mountFailure:
Filesystem startup failed; check configured disks
Use CD SYS: to retry; cold-boot after SIO failure

platform_pin.scope: GEM VDI development: FX 1.26 at D600, private 512 KiB VRAM, inactive at cold boot. Detection only is tested by G0.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

mouse_input.mapping: unmodified built-in preset; all other input maps disabled in isolated test profile
mouse_input.host_path: ATInputManager::OnMouseMove(0, dx, dy); OnButtonChanged(0, MouseLMB, state)
mouse_input.sensitivity: default preset: 16 integer host units per electrical transition; no mapping acceleration
mouse_input.capture: headless scheduled relative motion; GUI uses normal host mouse capture
mouse_input.observer: EXEC816_MOUSE_TRACE=1 logs MOUSE_HOST and passive MOUSE_PHASE in base scheduler cycles; unset for replay
mouse_input.controller_timing: Unmodified slow (scanline) scheduler: each phase delay clamps 0x1000000/remaining fixed-point distance to 1..256 scanlines. The passive observer timestamps output on the base CPU scheduler.

resident_provider_allowances.basis: Merged console/FastBasic bindings consumed 4 KiB of the former 16 KiB code growth allowance; responsive-editor copy/snapshot bindings consume another 4 KiB. Retain 8 KiB code, 4 KiB tables and 16 KiB data/BSS inside the existing provider banks.

memory.production_concurrency: The 12-Task desktop leaves one 2560-byte pool for GemARC or QED. Their joint test uses a controller without the desktop APP; no pools were enlarged.

contexts: Legacy path/Save selector callers pass NULL; the multi-file callback is retired
Native deletion follows the outer asynchronous decision; saving borrows a frozen ring
Linked new_edit/restore_edit use Open or unchecked Delete
wi_top invokes disabled Update, whose test returns false
Fixed common runtime Ops; QED registers no atexit handlers

limits: Development checks and selected package walks do not qualify the hosted system.
The full-write diagnostic timed out while filling 720/360 KiB from empty. The accepted disk-full case seeds a consistent 360 KiB volume and exercises actual native exhaustion and preservation.
Per-case manifests bind the exact emitted APPs and observers; early allocation/core cases precede the later cursor-only GUI fix.
